title: List toolbar: withhold the "In a queue" toggle on a view whose own filter pins owner_id — on HotCRM's "My Open Deals" it can only return an empty list
body:
Follow-up to #28428. Does not reopen #26359 (ruling A: the `queue` column stays on every `ownership: 'user'` object).

## What happens

HotCRM 6.4.0 (`@objectstack/*` 18.5.0) now declares two queues, `lead_intake` and `case_intake`, so `hasAnyQueue` is true and the **In a queue** toggle (「在队列中」) is back on every owned list.

On Opportunities → **My Open Deals** the toggle is offered, and turning it on always empties the list:

- the view's own filter is `owner_id equals {current_user_id}` (plus `stage not_in [closed_won, closed_lost]`)
- the toggle adds `owner_id is_empty` AND `queue is_not_empty` (`QUEUE_SITTING_CONDITIONS`)

`owner_id = me` AND `owner_id is_empty` has no rows, whatever the data. A user reads the empty list as "nothing is waiting in a queue", which the list never checked.

## Reading (origin/main `64c426ab22`, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`)

- line 1017: `QUEUE_SITTING_CONDITIONS`
- line 2551: `queueFilterOffered = hasAnyQueue === true && objectHasOwnershipQueue(objectDef)`
- line 6520: the toggle renders on `queueFilterOffered && !datasetChartOnScreen`

Nothing reads the active view's filter, so the contradiction is not seen.

## Target

Do not render the toggle when the active view's filter has a top-level AND condition that requires `owner_id` to hold a value (`equals`, `in`, `is_not_empty`). A condition inside an OR group does not count. No new key, no server reading, no contract change.

Same rule as #28428 and #27831: offer an affordance only when it can do something.

## Size of it in HotCRM

12 view filters across 10 view files pin `owner_id equals {current_user_id}` (accounts, opportunities, forecasts, events, tasks, leads, cases, timesheets, time entries, expenses). Every one shows a toggle that cannot return a row.

## Acceptance

1. HotCRM Opportunities → My Open Deals: no **In a queue** toggle.
2. Opportunities → All Opportunities: toggle unchanged.
3. Leads and Cases lists with no owner condition: toggle unchanged, and it still returns the records sitting in `lead_intake` / `case_intake`.
4. Switching from a pinned view to an unpinned one brings the toggle back in the off state.

## Open question for the maintainer (not part of the acceptance)

#28428 left per-object narrowing as a follow-up "if the dev sees real pull". HotCRM is now that case: none of its 32 object files declares `ownership`, so every owned list shows the toggle, while assignment rules route only `crm_lead` and `crm_case` into a queue.

Any narrowing has to respect #26359 and ADR-0142 D1: a queue binds to no object, and a record of any owned object can be moved into one by hand. A signal derived from assignment rules would therefore hide the toggle on an object that does hold queued records. This is a ruling, not a dev choice, so it is raised here and left out of the target above.
